description: Operate a running app session semantically: fill fields and fire an event, then get the new agent snapshot. `values` { "<field id | model path | name>": value } (table cells as "<table path or id>/<row>/<COLUMN>", e.g. "/T_TAB/2/SELKZ" to select a row) go out as the model delta of the roundtrip; `event` is an action's event name or its id ("a3"); `row` (0-based) fills the row-dependent arguments of a row action ("$row:FIELD", "$source:text", and the row-valued event parameters such as ${$parameters>/listItem}.getBindingContext()...); on a SelectDialog/TableSelectDialog the `confirm` action is the pick: `row` selects that row as a click does (its selectionField, sent as the model delta) and fills selectedItem/selectedContexts arguments from it; `args` (positional, null = let the client fill it) supplies arguments the browser would compute ("$expr:...", "$parameters:...", a message box's "$action"). Without `event` the values stay pending, as typing does in the browser. Strict: an event that is not among the snapshot's actions, a field that is not on the screen or not editable, a choice outside its values is refused - the error names what is allowed - and nothing is sent. "@CLOSE_POPUP" / "@CLOSE_POPOVER" actions close the dialog locally, as the browser does without a roundtrip. A WINDOWED table (window_bind_tab: the model holds the first rows, the backend the rest) says so in the snapshot - `rowCount` the rows held, `total` all rows the filter lets through, `truncated`, and `window.more` naming the call: `window` { table, count?, sort?, filter? } asks the backend for more rows, or for the first rows of a new sort or filter over ALL rows (e.g. { table: "t1", filter: [["STATUS", "EQ", "OPEN"]], sort: [{ column: "DUE", descending: true }] }) - no event, the app does not run; an unknown column or operator is refused. A cell edit addresses the rows as held, in the order the backend sent them. "@BINDING_CALL" actions (a sort or filter button of such a table) send the same request. The new snapshot is fitted to one answer like app_start's.

args.description: event arguments, positional to the action's `args`; null where the client fills the value in

event.description: the action to fire: its event name (e.g. "SAVE") or its id ("a3")

format.description: optional: "adaptive-card" adds the screen as an Adaptive Card 1.5 (an embedded resource, application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive) after the snapshot - for hosts that render cards (Copilot, Teams); default "snapshot" (or the server's A2UI5_MCP_APP_FORMAT)

max_rows.description: table rows per table in the answer (default: what app_start used)

row.description: for a row action: the row index (0-based) in its table - for a selection dialog's confirm, the row to pick

values.description: { "<field id, model path or name>": value, "<table path>/<row>/<COLUMN>": value }

window.description: a window request for a WINDOWED table (one whose snapshot carries `total` and `window`): { table: "<table id or path>", count?: rows wanted counted from row 1 (default: the next window, or one window after a sort/filter), sort?: [{ column, descending? }], filter?: [condition | [condition, ...]] } - a condition is ["COLUMN", "OPERATOR", value, value2?] (EQ NE LT LE GT GE BT NB Contains NotContains StartsWith NotStartsWith EndsWith NotEndsWith); list items are ANDed, the conditions of an inner list ORed; a part left out is kept by the backend, [] clears it. Instead of `event`; `values` travel with it

name: app_act
